title: What About Bob?: Bill Murray's Psychiatric Comedy
imageHint: Therapist's office in disarray with patient causing comedic mayhem and doctor looking exasperated
description: Bob Wiley, a multi-phobic psychiatric patient, follows his therapist on vacation, leading to hilarious chaos and unexpected life lessons.

questions.question: Who plays Bob Wiley, the neurotic patient with multiple phobias?
questions.explanation: Bill Murray brilliantly portrays Bob Wiley, a lovably neurotic patient suffering from multiple phobias who becomes obsessed with his psychiatrist.

questions.question: Who plays Dr. Leo Marvin, Bob's increasingly frustrated psychiatrist?
questions.explanation: Richard Dreyfuss plays Dr. Leo Marvin, the self-important psychiatrist whose vacation is ruined when Bob follows him to Lake Winnipesaukee.

questions.question: What is Dr. Marvin's therapeutic technique that he teaches Bob?
questions.explanation: Dr. Marvin teaches Bob the 'baby steps' method - taking small, manageable steps toward overcoming fears and achieving goals.

questions.question: What is the name of the lake where Dr. Marvin has his vacation home?
questions.explanation: Lake Winnipesaukee in New Hampshire is where Dr. Marvin's family vacation takes place, and where Bob creates chaos by following them.

questions.question: What is the title of Dr. Marvin's new book that he's promoting?
questions.explanation: Dr. Marvin has written a self-help book called 'Baby Steps' which ironically becomes the method that actually helps Bob improve his life.
